title: Candidate typed prescribed-groundwater-level trial contract

control.meaning: prescribed groundwater-level elevation for one trial window
distinct_from: current F-GC lower coupling-plane interface head
control.time_semantics: constant trial coordinate over the coupling window for the first research slice; legacy DATE1 interpolation is not part of LOW01-A/B/D

branch_rule.inside_profile: z_face_bottom < H_phreatic < z(1)-1e-4 cm, with active Richards nodes determined from declared centers and branch tolerance
branch_rule.below_profile: H_phreatic <= z_face_bottom, mapped to hbot = H_phreatic-z(n)+0.5*dz(n)

geometry.note: The typed branch rule must not read an undeclared z(n+1) sentinel.

immutable_origin: all process and numerical continuation state owned by the enclosing FMR trial
candidate_outputs: fllowgwl/below-profile branch diagnostic or typed equivalent

constitutive_ownership.rule: All hydraulic state created by the typed route must come from one declared constitutive authority.
constitutive_ownership.below_profile: The ordinary provider-owned HeadCalc path is reusable after the geometry branch is typed.
constitutive_ownership.inside_profile: Saturated continuation theta_s and interface conductivity must come from the explicit constitutive parameter/provider authority or an independently qualified source-exact adapter; direct legacy-global cofgen/watcon/hconduc use is not acceptable typed ownership.
constitutive_ownership.above_top: Same ownership rule applies to the special fully saturated/top branch.

qbot.role: diagnosed output of the prescribed-groundwater-level trial
qbot.inside_profile: Use the source-declared vertical flux-chain reconstruction after candidate storage/process state is known.
qbot.below_profile: Use the accepted prescribed-head equivalent lower-face flux materialization, with the mode-1 derived hbot and identical arithmetic authority as the qualified mode-5 accepted-step qbot path.

transaction.trial_origin: Every H_phreatic trial begins from one immutable accepted origin.
transaction.reject: Restore all hydraulic, groundwater-level, active-domain, process and numerical continuation state.
transaction.accept: Publish exactly one candidate and exactly one mass authority after conjunctive coupled acceptance.
transaction.cross_route_isolation: No LOW01 state or selector may leak into current production mode-5 F-GC.

LOW01_A.title: Below-profile source-equivalent reduction
LOW01_A.gate: Typed H_phreatic below the profile derives hbot from declared bottom-face geometry and reproduces a mode-5 trial from the same origin in candidate state, qbot, storage and solver path within declared floating-point bounds.

LOW01_B.title: Inside-profile active-domain and saturated continuation
LOW01_B.gate: Typed H_phreatic inside the profile reproduces source-declared active-node truncation, provider-owned saturated continuation, qbot and hard mass closure.

LOW01_C.title: Branch-boundary sweep
LOW01_C.gate: Prospective sweep across an internal node and bottom face records branch identity and continuity/discontinuity behavior without retuning.

LOW01_D.title: Immutable-origin replay and rejection
LOW01_D.gate: A-B-A prescribed H_phreatic trials from one accepted origin reproduce A bitwise or within source-declared deterministic bounds; rejected B leaves no state or mass authority.
dependencies: LOW01_A or LOW01_B admitted research slice

activation.immediate: LOW01-A design and source-level implementation may proceed once the explicit geometry rule is implemented in research-only support.
activation.blocked: LOW01-B live qualification is blocked by unresolved explicit constitutive ownership in the current mode-1 special branch.
activation.hlink04: Remain blocked until LOW01-A, LOW01-B and LOW01-D are qualified and LOW01-C is at least characterized.

forbidden: do not add bottom_mode=1 to production validate_legacy_request from this contract
do not overload boundary.bottom_head as both H_phreatic and hbot in a future production API
do not synthesize z(n+1) by undocumented convention
do not use FSI04 constant legacy constitutive stubs as evidence of real typed saturated continuation
do not infer current mode-5 F-GC becomes obsolete
